views.full: seeded reservoir sample of <= max_samples eval-partition rows (same draw as v1.0/v1.1)
views.clean: every eval-partition row from the dataset's official TEST split - for the prompt-injection streams this excludes rows the Horizon models were trained on (deepset/jackhhao train)

horizon-guard-base.validation_set: dev partition AND official test split (deepset ingress+egress, jackhhao ingress)
horizon-guard-base.rule: max pooled F1 over tau_elevated <= tau_clean; pairs within 0.005 F1 of the best are tied; among tied pairs take the highest precision, then the plateau median

horizon-guard-small.validation_set: dev partition AND official test split (deepset ingress+egress, jackhhao ingress)
horizon-guard-small.rule: max pooled F1 over tau_elevated <= tau_clean; pairs within 0.005 F1 of the best are tied; among tied pairs take the highest precision, then the plateau median
